report:
Long questions now show both the yes and no buttons, and short rows look the same as before.

**Change:** in `src/components/QuestionRow.tsx`, I added `flex: 1` to the `question` text style. The title had no flex or shrink setting, so a long title took the whole row and pushed the buttons off-screen. With `flex: 1` the title wraps in the space left over and the buttons stay at the right edge.

**Checked on the iPhone 17 simulator, after reloading with the change:**
- **Long rows in Cleaning:** "Are the customer toilets cleaned…" and "Is the area behind the bakery ovens…" both wrap to 3–4 lines, with yes and no visible at the right.
- **Short rows:** "Floors clean", "Bins emptied", "Trolley bay tidy" and "Entrance mats clean" are on a single line, with the buttons aligned in the same column as the long rows. The red "!" markers still show.
- **Taps:** I tapped yes on the toilets row and no on the bakery-oven row. Each button highlighted, and the counter went from "0 of 48" to "2 of 48 answered".

I did not capture a "before" screenshot, so the bug itself is inferred from the code and not seen in the app. I only looked at the Cleaning section and parts of Safety, Food safety and Security, not all 48 rows.
